as_told.title: UFO cover-up began as a presidential emergency action document

plain: In the 1950s, President Dwight D. Eisenhower is said to have used secret orders called presidential emergency action directives, special White House instructions for emergencies, to cover the UFO subject. Eric W. Davis, a Pentagon scientist, says these orders "were instituted in the Eisenhower White House administration." He says they have since been used for many topics, but that he and a man named Jim Semivan know they were set up "for this topic." A guest named Grant Cameron also credits Semivan but does not name Eisenhower. He says this kind of document is "how it started, which means it's an executive program. The president is running the cover up." If so, the secrecy would come from the top of government, not from some lower office.
